name: The Bloodsail Buccaneers
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
The map shows Booty Bay with a red "X" drawn precisely at the spot at which you are standing.

The scribbled text reads:

"You men are to secure a camp at this location and keep quiet.  Wait for the signal from the southern command post before attacking.  If anyone approaches you, kill them."
narrative.objectives: Report your findings to First Mate Crazz in Booty Bay.
narrative.offerRewardText: Sure, I remember you, Champion. Back from scouting I see....
